label.overall_validation: The evaluator validates the final social-cover SVG and PNG. It checks the SVG canvas dimensions, the exact scene_title text, required added copy as real SVG text elements, top-right placement for the badge copy, and the exported PNG dimensions.

main_functions.name: check_inkscape_document_properties
main_functions.description: Checks the SVG document width and height against the expected values, using width/height or viewBox with a small tolerance.

main_functions.name: check_inkscape_text_content
main_functions.description: Checks that a specific element id contains exactly the expected text.

main_functions.name: check_inkscape_text_element
main_functions.description: Checks that required copy exists as a standalone SVG text element and optionally falls within a requested page region.

main_functions.name: check_png_dimensions
main_functions.description: Opens the exported PNG with PIL and verifies its exact width and height.

helper_functions.name: _parse_svg
helper_functions.description: Parses the SVG XML and returns the tree and root node, or None values on failure.

helper_functions.name: _position
helper_functions.description: Extracts a text element position from x/y attributes, child x/y attributes, and simple translate transforms.
